title: Cherry Villages! (Mot's Structures)
description: This mod/datapack adds not-so-complex - vanilla like structures into the game using only vanilla blocks that already are in the game.
body:
### Structures: ###

- **Resin Crypt:** a crypt under the pale garden with trial spawners, creakings, secrets, fallen illagers and unique loot.
- **Cherry Village:** a peaceful village in the cherry grove.
- **Mangrove village:** a village hybrid of villagers and witches.
- **Mushroom village:** a rare, small and precarious village found only in mushroom islands.
- **Pale manor:** a small manor surrounded by the pale garden with a secret at the top of it + a map chart pointing to the resin crypt.
- **Lonely huts:** big isolated houses of villagers all around the different biomes + map charts to other structures.
- **Landmarks/POIs:** small common structures all around the different biomes.
- **Air Baloons:** hot air baloons controlled by villagers all around the different biomes + map charts to other structures.


### Custom textures info: ###
This mod uses a map chart system like the one in DnT aswell as custom trail keys.


**Datapack:**
To give the custom textures to the charts and keys, you'll need to download the recourcepack and load it.
If they still apear to be missing, try loading it again at the top of the active recourcepack list.


**Mod loaders:**
The mod already gives custom textures to charts and keys, so if they apear to be missing, try loading the mod with higher priority in your mod list or dowload and activate the recourcepack.


![Logo](https://cdn.modrinth.com/data/cached_images/59aa65b76b93733ba60b0267aef5c49b90b7ca2a.png)

If you want to make a structure stop spawning in the world, you need to go to "data\mot_structures\worldgen\structure" and remove the structure you dislike.

You can use this mod in any modpack you'd like and there is no need to give me credit when doing so.

You can modify my mod/datapack to your liking, but you are not allowed to distribute the modified product nor claim it as your own!

This is my first mod/datapack! I hope you like it and if you have any suggestions or have found any bugs/errors in it, leave feedback please, I'd really appreciate it.

This mod/datapack is in an early stage of development. Expect things to change.
